subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers land the open fork cleanup PR, adopt it into a same-repo branch, or close that candidate and keep this issue as the canonical bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and narrow, but an open unmerged fork PR already owns the proposed fix path and is not maintainer-modifiable, so automation should not queue a duplicate fix before a human chooses the landing path.

options.title: Review or replace the fork cleanup
options.body: Treat the open fork PR as the current candidate, then either land it after proof/refresh or replace it with an equivalent same-repo branch.

options.title: Close the fork candidate only
options.body: If the fork branch is not usable, close that candidate but keep this issue open as the canonical source-reproducible bug.

options.title: Defer behind broader lifecycle work
options.body: Leave this issue open without active implementation if maintainers want to sequence it with the related message-tool placeholder lifecycle issue.

recommendation.title: Review or replace the fork cleanup
recommendation.body: Treat the open fork PR as the current candidate, then either land it after proof/refresh or replace it with an equivalent same-repo branch.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history in the Google Chat reply-delivery and placeholder hardening path where the fix belongs.
